`UnifiedActivationPipeline` in `.aios-core/development/scripts/unified-activation-pipeline.js` is the sole entry point for all 12 agents; `generate-greeting.js` delegates to `UnifiedActivationPipeline.activate(agentId)`. `GreetingBuilder` assembles greetings with pre-loaded context. `buildGreeting()` calls `loadUserProfile()` and passes it to `_buildContextualGreeting()`; `GreetingPreferenceManager.getPreference(userProfile)` accepts optional profile (bob restriction). PM bypasses bob restriction; bob non-PM `auto` redirects, forced `named` greets. Phases: 1 parallel 5 loaders (`Promise.all`), 2 agent definition, 3 sequential preference/session/workflow, 4 enriched context, 5 `GreetingBuilder`.

8 agents use `visibility: [full, quick, key]`; `qa`, `data-engineer`, `devops`, `ux-design-expert` lack metadata and use first 12 commands; `aios-master` uses `visibility: full`. Bob non-PM returns empty commands. `*yolo` is universal. Badge: `_safeGetPermissionBadge()` in `greeting-builder.js`.

When mocking `resolveConfig`, use `mockReturnValue` (not `mockReturnValueOnce`) if called multiple times. `validate-user-profile.js` `validateUserProfile()` is pure/no filesystem. Always mock `fs`, `js-yaml`, `config-resolver`, and dependency modules BEFORE requiring the module under test. `resolveConfig()` merges L1-L5; L5 `user-config.yaml` wins. `user_profile` is USER_FIELD in `migrate-config.js`. `toggleUserProfile()` flips bob↔advanced. `PermissionMode`/`OperationGuard` in `.aios-core/core/permissions/` are functional; `cycleMode()`/`enforcePermission()` wire `index.js`; cycle `explore`(0)→`ask`(1)→`auto`(2) (`PermissionMode.MODE_CYCLE`).

Source `.aios-core/development/agents/`; Claude mirror `.claude/commands/AIOS/agents/`; separate files, synced separately by `ideSync`. Always match existing format when editing: structured (`name: xxx`) or compact (`key: 'value'`); compact: `qa`, `devops`, `data-engineer`, `ux-design-expert`.

Locks: use `fs.writeFile(path, data, { flag: 'wx' })`; include PID+timestamp; stale ~10s, timeout ~3s, poll 50ms. Temp `{path}.tmp.{pid}` + `fs.rename()`; Windows rename failure when target exists falls back to direct `fs.writeFile()`. Cache fingerprint: `.git/HEAD` mtime + `.git/index` mtime; use `git rev-parse --git-dir` (worktrees) and `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` (worktree detection). For dual lock/cache `writeFile`, broad `mockResolvedValue`, verify filtered `mock.calls`. Mock `child_process.execSync` separately from `execa`. Use `jest.requireActual('fs')` for real hook-existence checks.

Builders `buildPresentation`, `buildRoleDescription`, `buildProjectStatus`, `buildFooter`, `buildContextSection` accept optional `sectionContext`; `_buildContextualGreeting` creates/passes it. Present context => brief named greeting for existing/workflow; absent => archetypal backward-compatible. `_formatProjectStatusNarrative()` is natural language; legacy `_formatProjectStatus()` remains without context. `_safeBuildSection(fn)` uses SECTION_TIMEOUT (150ms)+try/catch; `Promise.all([contextSection, workflowSection])` parallelizes. Footer: new `*guide`; existing `*help + *session-info`; workflow `Focused on **{story}**`. ACT-5 changes (lines 661-816 in greeting-builder.js) must NOT be touched -- they own workflow navigator section.

`VerificationGate` `.aios-core/core/ids/verification-gate.js`: Template Method. `CircuitBreaker` `.aios-core/core/ids/circuit-breaker.js`: CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN. Gates `.aios-core/core/ids/gates/g{n}-*.js` use `IncrementalDecisionEngine.analyze()` (PUBLIC API only): G1/G2 advisory, G3 soft block/overrideable, G4 informational/logged. `verify()` handles timeout/circuit/logging and delegates `_doVerify()`. Degrade: timeout warn-and-proceed, error log-and-proceed, open skip. G3 override check ne
